FN-F29SDCD-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 106
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/13/2025
House Bill 106 as introduced could decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the additional amounts contributed to catastrophe savings
accounts due to the increased caps on contributions provided by this bill.
Page 1

FN-F29SDCD-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 106
Committee: Insurance Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/19/2025
House Bill 106 as reported by the Committee on Insurance could decrease receipts to the
Education Trust Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, by an undetermined amount dependent
upon the additional amounts contributed to catastrophe savings accounts due to the increased
caps on contributions provided by this bill.

FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 106
Committee: Banking and Insurance Sponsor: Representative Chip Brown
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 106 as passed the House of Representatives could decrease receipts to the Education
Trust Fund, beginning in Fiscal Year 2027, by an undetermined amount dependent upon the
additional amounts contributed to catastrophe savings accounts due to the increased caps on
contributions provided by this bill.
